mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT from t-1w to t-0w signals more commuting and downtown foot traffic, which lifts retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -54.0 to -50.1 and TRANSIT improved from -56.3 to -53.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise again next week but RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated, residents are spending more time near home and making more neighborhood purchases, which increases RETAIL_REC within two weeks even if workplace mobility is still depressed.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays at or above +13 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 14.1 at t-0w and 13.0 at t-1w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains at or above +13 for two weeks and RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days, the claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: An upward move in PARKS relative to the prior week reflects warmer or more permissive outdoor behavior that spills over into nearby retail visits, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -20.9 at t-3w to -16.3 at t-1w before returning to -20.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS rises over a four-week span but RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the previous four weeks, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp recovery in TRANSIT after sustained weakness marks relaxed mobility frictions; once transit is less suppressed, retail trips follow with a one-week lag and RETAIL_REC rises.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 2 points week-on-week after at least three weeks below -55
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -56.3 at t-1w to -53.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT clears the threshold but RETAIL_REC does not improve in the following week, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Retail recovery requires simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT; commuting alone is insufficient, but when both rise together they create overlapping exposure that lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improved at t-0w relative to t-1w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises without a concurrent TRANSIT rise and RETAIL_REC still improves, or if both rise together but RETAIL_REC stays flat over 28 days, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM is the only category that improves while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain deeply negative, the retail rebound is limited to essential trips and RETAIL_REC stays below its prior four-week average.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises but WORKPLACES stays below -50 and TRANSIT stays below -53
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved to -24.4 at t-0w while WORKPLACES remained -50.1 and TRANSIT remained -53.9
failure_condition: If essential-shopping improvement coincides with a higher RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days despite weak WORKPLACES and TRANSIT, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS together with RESIDENTIAL suggests a weekend and local-activity pattern that usually precedes higher discretionary outings, increasing RETAIL_REC only in the warmer or outdoor-friendly regime.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves for two consecutive weeks while RESIDENTIAL stays above +13
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -20.9 at t-3w to -16.3 at t-1w and RESIDENTIAL stayed near 14
failure_condition: If PARKS and RESIDENTIAL satisfy the trigger but RETAIL_REC does not exceed the prior four-week mean within 28 days, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week improvement in TRANSIT followed by a matching rise in WORKPLACES indicates easing access to business districts; that sequence produces a delayed four-week increase in RETAIL_REC, but only when both series move in the same direction.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise week-on-week after at least two weeks of declines or flat readings
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improved at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT rises but WORKPLACES does not confirm within two weeks, or if both rise and RETAIL_REC does not improve over the following 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.
